## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Every gate raised by autopilot and autopilot-roadmap carries a...

The system SHALL ensure that every gate raised by autopilot and autopilot-roadmap carries a runner-computed tier, and the tier appears in loop-state and the dispatch result in tests covering each gate kind.

#### Scenario: Every gate raised by autopilot and autopilot-roadmap carries a...

WHEN `add-runner-computed-gate-tiers-to-autopilot-gates` is implemented
THEN Every gate raised by autopilot and autopilot-roadmap carries a runner-computed tier, and the tier appears in loop-state and the dispatch result in tests covering each gate kind.

### Requirement: Under the operator posture, auto-merge of an agent PR in this repository...

The system SHALL ensure that under the operator posture, auto-merge of an agent PR in this repository resolves as tier auto when CI is green on head, reviews have converged, and there is no security finding.

#### Scenario: Under the operator posture, auto-merge of an agent PR in this repository...

WHEN `add-runner-computed-gate-tiers-to-autopilot-gates` is implemented
THEN Under the operator posture, auto-merge of an agent PR in this repository resolves as tier auto when CI is green on head, reviews have converged, and there is no security finding.

### Requirement: A table-driven test shows that failing any one of the three auto-merge...

The system SHALL ensure that a table-driven test shows that failing any one of the three auto-merge conditions raises tier interrupt, and that a repository other than this one resolves the merge gate as block.

#### Scenario: A table-driven test shows that failing any one of the three auto-merge...

WHEN `add-runner-computed-gate-tiers-to-autopilot-gates` is implemented
THEN A table-driven test shows that failing any one of the three auto-merge conditions raises tier interrupt, and that a repository other than this one resolves the merge gate as block.

### Requirement: Tier computation is deterministic for a given gate kind, posture, and...

The system SHALL ensure that tier computation is deterministic for a given gate kind, posture, and evidence set, and the supervisor has no code path that sets or overrides a tier.

#### Scenario: Tier computation is deterministic for a given gate kind, posture, and...

WHEN `add-runner-computed-gate-tiers-to-autopilot-gates` is implemented
THEN Tier computation is deterministic for a given gate kind, posture, and evidence set, and the supervisor has no code path that sets or overrides a tier.
